changelog: Rebuilt for Postqued's v2 API. Adds all 62 tools, 11 platform schemas, organization/workspace boundaries, dry-run publishing, idempotency, approval concurrency, and durable status polling.
summary: Operate Postqued from OpenClaw across 62 tools for publishing, scheduling, analytics, engagement, approvals, collaboration, and client review. Includes the v2 API fallback and safety-first workflows. More information: https://postqued.com/openclaw
